services.subtitle: Complete solutions for your business's digital presence.

items.title: Web Development
items.description: Websites and systems built with modern technology and clean code.

details.explanation: Custom institutional websites and web systems, built on real source code with React and Next.js — not stacked on top of a generic page builder. That means full freedom over structure, performance, and integrations, without being locked into a third-party platform's limitations.
benefits: Measurable performance, not just promised — the same Core Web Vitals any audit tool can verify
Admin panel to keep text, photos, and content up to date without depending on a developer for every change
SEO-ready structure from the first commit (sitemap, metadata, structured data), not bolted on afterward
process: Testing and adjustments with the client
useCases: Institutional site for a company that needs a professional online presence
Portal with login and restricted area for clients or staff
Custom internal system for a specific business process
differentiators: Delivered in real source code, no builder vendor lock-in
Performance verifiable with public tools (Lighthouse, PageSpeed)
Direct support via WhatsApp during and after delivery, no ticket queue

items.title: Landing Pages
items.description: High-impact pages focused on conversion and lead capture.

details.explanation: A single page built around one goal only: capture a lead, sell a product, or validate a campaign. No menu splitting attention, no sections that don't help conversion — every element on the page exists to move the visitor toward the action.
benefits: Fast loading so you don't lose paid traffic right at the door
Structure designed for conversion, not just to look good
Easy to measure results — one page, one goal, one number to track
process: Copy and structure geared toward conversion
Integration with WhatsApp or a capture form
useCases: Landing page for a paid traffic campaign
Launch of a specific product or info product
Lead capture for an event or webinar
differentiators: Fastest delivery in the catalog (3-5 business days)
Focus on a single CTA, no distraction
Performance optimized so you don't lose conversions to slow loading

items.title: Web Platforms
items.description: Complete, custom systems for your business to scale.

details.explanation: Complete, custom web systems — dashboards, portals with multiple user roles, early-stage digital products. Built with architecture designed to grow alongside the business, not to be rewritten from scratch the moment it outgrows the basics.
benefits: Architecture that handles growth without having to start over later
Custom integrations for the business's actual workflow, not generic configuration
Full control over what's built and how it evolves
useCases: Portal with multiple user roles (client, admin, team)
Digital product (SaaS) in early stage, validating the market
differentiators: Modern stack (React, Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker)
Custom scope, no forced adaptation of a ready-made template
Direct follow-up with whoever actually builds the system

items.title: SEO & Performance
items.description: Search engine optimization and maximum speed.

details.explanation: Technical SEO and performance optimization — for a new site or an existing one. Covers everything from indexing structure (sitemap, robots, structured data) to real loading performance, measured with the same tools Google uses to evaluate the site.
benefits: More organic visibility without relying only on paid ads
Structure prepared for both traditional search engines and AI-generated answers
process: Technical audit of the current site
useCases: Existing site that doesn't show up in Google searches
Institutional site or e-commerce with slow loading
Business that depends on organic search to generate contacts
differentiators: Audit done directly on the real code, not just a generic automated report
Fixes applied by the developer, no middleman relaying the request
Follow-up with verifiable metrics (Lighthouse, Search Console)

items.title: Hosting & Infra
items.description: Premium servers with SSL, backups, and 24/7 monitoring.

details.explanation: Managed hosting with an SSL certificate, automatic backups, and continuous monitoring — no need to understand servers, DNS, or infrastructure configuration.
benefits: Site live with HTTPS from day one
Automatic backup so you don't lose anything if something goes wrong
Direct support if something goes down, no generic call-center support queue
useCases: Already have a site but current hosting is unstable or slow
Launching your first site and don't want to deal with infrastructure
Migrating from old hosting with zero downtime
differentiators: Direct support, not generic call-center tickets
Infrastructure on the same stack used in development, no compatibility workarounds

items.title: Integrations & APIs
items.description: Connect your site to payments, CRMs, and external tools.

details.explanation: Connecting your site to the tools the business already uses — payments, CRM, WhatsApp, spreadsheets — so data flows automatically instead of being copied by hand from one system to another.
benefits: Less manual work re-entering data between systems
The site becomes part of the sales or support flow instead of staying isolated
No relying on a generic plugin that breaks with every update
process: Defining the integration type (API, webhook, automation)
Validation with real data before going live
useCases: Accept payments directly on the site
Automatically send a lead to the CRM as soon as the form is submitted
Connect a form to a spreadsheet or internal system
differentiators: Custom integration for the business's actual workflow, not generic plugin configuration
Tested with real data before delivery, not just in a sample environment
Support to adjust the integration if the business workflow changes

founder.name: João Victor Rodrigues
bio: I'm a Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Python, working on new features, REST API integration, code refactoring, and bug fixing — always focused on performance, organization, and a great user experience.

I worked as a Front-End Developer at Pawkeepr, a smart pet-management platform, collaborating on a remote team to build and continuously evolve the product. I hold a degree in Systems Analysis and Development and I'm currently pursuing a postgraduate degree in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence.

I use AI tools such as Claude Code to speed up refactoring, boost productivity, and support software development — combining that with solid engineering practices to deliver robust, scalable, production-ready systems.

faq.subtitle: Get your questions about our services answered.

items.a: It depends on your goal. For a capture page, Launch is ideal. For companies that need a complete website, Business. For platforms and systems, Premium. And for startups, MVP.
Launch is delivered in 3-5 business days, Business in 7-15 business days. Premium and MVP plans vary depending on project scope.
Yes! Hosting is where your site lives on the internet. We offer premium hosting for R$ 185/month with SSL, backups, and support included.

items.q: Can I edit my site myself?
items.a: Yes! On the Business and Premium plans you get an admin panel to change text, photos, and manage content without depending on code.
MVP stands for Minimum Viable Product. It's a functional version of your product that lets you validate your idea in the market quickly and at low cost — ideal for startups.
Payment is split into two parts: the one-time development investment and monthly hosting. We accept PIX, card, and bank slip (boleto).

items.q: Will my site show up on Google?
items.a: Yes! All our sites are built with a structure ready for SEO, including a sitemap, optimized tags, and performance aligned with Google's Web Vitals.

items.q: Does the site work on mobile?
items.a: Yes! All our sites are 100% responsive, working perfectly on desktops, tablets, and phones.

items.q: What if I need adjustments after delivery?
items.a: Small adjustments within the scope agreed on in the quote are included during the delivery period. Changes outside the original scope (new pages, extra features) are quoted separately.
